items.explanation: The sentence refers to a completed action before a past deadline, so the simple past "submitted" is correct.

items.prompt: Please send your expense claims _____ the accounting department by the 15th.
items.explanation: We "send something to" a person or department. "To" marks the recipient.

items.prompt: Ms. Ortega gave a _____ presentation on the new client onboarding process.
items.explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun "presentation." "Persuasive" correctly modifies the noun.

items.passageText:
Dear colleagues,

Our downtown branch will move to 480 Harbor Avenue next month. The new suite offers more meeting rooms and better transit access. _____ packing guidelines will be emailed to each team lead this week.

Thank you for your cooperation.
Facilities Team
items.prompt: Select the best word or phrase for the blank.
items.explanation: "Detailed" is an adjective modifying "packing guidelines." The other options do not fit grammatically before the noun.

items.passageText:
Dear colleagues,

Our downtown branch will move to 480 Harbor Avenue next month. The new suite offers more meeting rooms and better transit access. Detailed packing guidelines will be emailed to each team lead this week.

Staff _____ expected to label boxes clearly and leave personal items at home on moving day.

Thank you for your cooperation.
Facilities Team
items.prompt: Select the best word or phrase for the blank.
items.explanation: "Staff" is treated as a plural group here with "are expected." "Are" agrees with the plural sense of the subject.

items.passageText:
TO: All North Region employees
FROM: Priya Raman, HR Director
DATE: March 3
SUBJECT: Flexible hours pilot — April to June

Starting April 1, North Region staff may choose a start time between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m., provided they complete an eight-hour workday and attend the Tuesday 9:30 a.m. team standup in person or online.

Managers must approve each schedule in the HR portal by March 20. The pilot will be reviewed in early July. Employees who prefer a fixed 9:00–5:00 schedule do not need to take any action.

Questions may be sent to hr-north@summitline.example.
items.prompt: What is the main purpose of this memo?

options.text: To announce a temporary flexible-hours program
To require all staff to start at 7:00 a.m.

items.explanation: The subject and body introduce a flexible-hours pilot from April to June. Other options contradict the memo.
